title: Adobe style · Aptitude, Technical + Coding
description: Short aptitude and technical sections, then two hard problems. 20 MCQs + 2 coding problems in 90 minutes. Original practice questions modelled on the publicly reported test pattern. Not an official or past paper.

questions.text: A can do a job in 45 days and B in 36 days. They work together for 2 days, then B leaves. In how many more days will A finish the job?
questions.explanation: In 2 days they do 1/10 of the work; 9/10 is left, which A does in 9/10 × 45 = 81/2 days.

questions.text: What are the roots of x² - 3x + 2 = 0?
questions.explanation: Sum of roots = 3, product = 2: the roots are 1 and 2.

questions.text: What is the smaller angle between the hour and minute hands of a clock at 5:40?
If today is Friday, what day of the week will it be after 195 days?
questions.explanation: 195 mod 7 = 6; Friday + 6 days = Thursday.

questions.text: The average age of 10 students is 54 years. When the teacher's age is included, the average decreases by 2 years. What is the teacher's age?
questions.explanation: New total = 52 × 11 = 572; old total = 540; teacher = 32.

questions.text: In a code language, HAMMER is written as VIQQEL. How is CAMERA written in that code?
questions.explanation: Each letter is shifted +4 and the word is then reversed.

questions.text: Which number is the odd one out: 57, 117, 54, 72?
questions.explanation: 57 — all others are multiples of 9.

questions.text: Meera is the father of Nikhil. Nikhil is the sister of Bharat. How is Meera related to Bharat?
questions.explanation: Bharat is Nikhil's sibling, so Meera is Bharat's father too.

questions.text: Isha's father is the only son of Pooja's father. Pooja is Isha's ____ if Pooja is female.
questions.explanation: Pooja is a daughter of Isha's grandfather and not Isha's mother (his father is the only son), so she is Isha's aunt.

questions.text: What is the decimal value of hexadecimal 92?

What is printed?

count = 0

questions.explanation: Counting the inner iterations gives 21.

questions.text:
What is the output? (div = integer division)

n = 9984
r = 0
while n > 0
    r = r * 10 + (n mod 10)
    n = n div 10
end while
print r
questions.explanation: Trace the loop digit by digit.

questions.text: Starting with an empty queue (push = enqueue, pop = dequeue), these operations run: push(40), pop(), push(10), push(44), pop(), push(20), pop(), push(33), pop(). What is at the front now?
questions.explanation: Simulating the operations, the front element is 33.

questions.text: Given the function f(n) = 0 if n == 0 else n + f(n - 1), what is f(4)?
questions.explanation: Expanding the recursion gives f(4) = 10.

questions.text:
